capabilities: Capture a chosen display at native resolution via a hotkey
Save the PNG into a configurable vault folder
Insert the image at the cursor as an embed, markdown link, or plain link
Configure display index, filename format, and shutter sound
disambiguation: It captures an entire display, not a selected region or window like the system screenshot shortcut.
extras: macOS only (isDesktopOnly: true); requires granting Screen Recording permission to Obsidian and restarting; performs no network calls.
motivation: The author built it for note-taking during online lectures: keep Obsidian on the main monitor and snap the course screen straight into notes.
problem: Capturing a second display during lectures requires leaving Obsidian and manually saving and inserting the screenshot.

requires.name: macOS Screen Recording permission for Obsidian

summary: Screenshot tool that captures a chosen monitor with a hotkey and embeds the image at the cursor, macOS only.
